blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **один → одного** — genitive masculine and accusative masculine, with an animate noun. The number “ОДИН” acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case.
exercises.prompt: Genitive masculine and accusative masculine, with an animate noun

exercises.why: **один → одному** — dative masculine. The number “ОДИН” acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case.
**один → одним** — instrumental masculine. The number “ОДИН” acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case.
**один → одном** — prepositional masculine. The number “ОДИН” acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case.
**одна → одной** — genitive, dative, instrumental and prepositional feminine. The number “ОДИН” acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case.
exercises.prompt: Genitive, dative, instrumental and prepositional feminine

exercises.why: **одна → одну** — accusative feminine. The number “ОДИН” acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case.
**одно → одного** — genitive neuter. The number “ОДИН” acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case.
**одно → одному** — dative neuter. The number “ОДИН” acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case.
**одно → одним** — instrumental neuter. The number “ОДИН” acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case.
**одно → одном** — prepositional neuter. The number “ОДИН” acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case.
